description: The plugin's hooks. Two gate a dispatch (issue #28): smoke-trailer.sh keeps a dispatch commit from landing without its smoke: trailer, and review-gate.sh keeps the dispatch session from ending on an unanswered reviewer change-request; both read stop_hook_active and let a second stop through, so neither can loop. caveman.sh (issue #43) asks a Fire, and only a Fire, for terse prose; AUTO_AGENT_CAVEMAN=off in the Host env turns it off, and it never blocks a prompt.
